caption: a $Set$ is read the same way as a list
repeats are ignored: the members are $\{1,2,3\}$
exact rationals count too; this is $\{1,2,3\}$ scaled by $\tfrac12$
a Sidon set: all sums $a+b$ with $a\le b$ differ, so only the trivial quadruples remain, $2|A|^2-|A|$
an arithmetic progression has the energy of $\{1,\dots,4\}$, $(2\cdot 4^3+4)/3$
swapping the two sets changes nothing
